title: CI: Run Storybook tests only on `main` pushes
body:
`storybook-tests.yml` was running a heavy Storybook pipeline on both pushes and PRs (`main`/`develop`), creating avoidable PR CI overhead. This change narrows it to post-merge validation on `main` only and removes dead PR-only logic.

- **Workflow trigger scope reduction**
  - Updated `.github/workflows/storybook-tests.yml` to run only on:
    - `push` to `main`
    - existing path filters (`packages/**`, `.storybook/**`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`)
  - Removed the `pull_request` trigger entirely.
  - Removed `develop` from push branches.

- **Removed unreachable PR-only step**
  - Deleted the visual regression step gated by `if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'`, since this workflow no longer runs on PR events.

- **Workflow cleanup**
  - Simplified concurrency grouping to `storybook-tests-${{ github.ref }}` (PR context no longer applies).

- **Changelog**
  - Added an `Unreleased` changelog entry documenting the Storybook CI scope reduction.

```yaml
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'packages/**'
      - '.storybook/**'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
```

<!-- START COPILOT ORIGINAL PROMPT -->



<details>

<summary>Original prompt</summary>

> ## Problem
> 
> The `storybook-tests.yml` workflow currently runs on both `push` and `pull_request` events for `main` and `develop` branches. This is one of the heaviest CI jobs because it:
> 
> 1. Builds **all** packages (`pnpm build`)
> 2. Builds **Storybook** (`pnpm storybook:build`)
> 3. Installs **Playwright** browsers
> 4. Runs **Storybook interaction tests** (`pnpm storybook:ci`)
> 5. On PRs, also runs **visual regression tests** with snapshots
> 
> This causes significant CI overhead on every PR, slowing down the feedback loop for contributors.
> 
> ## Solution
> 
> Simplify the CI by restricting `storybook-tests.yml` to only run on pushes to `main` (post-merge gate). This is safe because:
> 
> - Storybook tests are **integration/visual tests**, not unit tests — they catch regressions after merge
> - The core `ci.yml` workflow already runs unit tests, build verification, and E2E tests on PRs
> - Storybook Deploy (`storybook-deploy.yml`) already only runs on `main`
> - The visual regression snapshot tests only run on PRs anyway, so if we move the entire workflow to main-only, we should remove the PR-specific visual regression step
> 
> ## Changes Required
> 
> Edit `.github/workflows/storybook-tests.yml`:
> 
> 1. **Remove** the `pull_request` trigger entirely
> 2. **Remove** the `develop` branch from the `push` trigger — only keep `main`
> 3. **Remove** the visual regression test step (lines 84-89) since it was conditional on `github.event_name == 'pull_request'` which will never be true anymore
> 
> The resulting trigger section should be:
> 
> ```yaml
> on:
>   push:
>     branches: [main]
>     paths:
>       - 'packages/**'
>       - '.storybook/**'
>       - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
> ```
> 
> And remove this step entirely:
> ```yaml
>       - name: Run visual regression tests
>         if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
>         run: |
>           concurrently -k -s first \
>             "pnpm storybook --no-open" \
>             "wait-on tcp:6006 && pnpm storybook:test:snapshot"
> ```
> 
> 4. **Update CHANGELOG.md** with this CI optimization change.
> 
>

> Here's a summary of the current workflow landscape and the optimization plan:
> 
> **Current Workflows:**
> 
> | Workflow | Triggers | Analysis |
> |---|---|---|
> | `ci.yml` | push/PR on `main, develop` | Core CI — test, build, e2e, docs. **Should keep on PRs.** |
> | `storybook-tests.yml` | push/PR on `main, develop` (path-filtered) | **Heavy** — builds all packages + storybook + Playwright. **Move to main-only.** |
> | `storybook-deploy.yml` | push on `main` only | Already main-only ✅ |
> | `lint.yml` | `workflow_dispatch` only | Already manual ✅ |
> | `performance-budget.yml` | push/PR on `main, develop` (path-filtered) | Bundle analysis. **Could move to main-only or keep PR with path filter.** |
> | `check-links.yml` | `workflow_dispatch` only | Already manual ✅ |
> | `shadcn-check.yml` | weekly schedule + manual | Already optimized ✅ |
> 
> **Proposed changes:**
> 
> 1. **`storybook-tests.yml`** — Remove `pull_request` trigger entirely; only run on `push` to `main`. This is the biggest win since it does a full build + Storybook build + Playwright.
> 2. **`performance-budget.yml`** — Keep PR comments (useful for bundle review), but this could optionally also be main-only. I'll keep it on PRs since the path filter already limits it and PR comments are valuable.
